issues.issue: Is the claimant a Convention refugee due to imputed political opinion as a UDPS member?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant alleges Convention refugee status due to UDPS membership and political persecution fears.
issues.respondent_position: Claimant not credible; failed to establish participation in opposition activities or credible fear of persecution.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not credibly establish Convention refugee status under section 96 IRPA.

issues.issue: Is the claimant a person in need of protection fearing arrest, detention, and torture by government and ANR?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears arrest, detention, and torture due to opposition membership and protest participation.
issues.respondent_position: Claimant not credible; no evidence supports risk of persecution or torture; no separate section 97 analysis warranted.
issues.result_text: Claimant not credible; no evidence supports person in need of protection claim.
